label: HTTP API
description: An HTTP base URL with headers every request carries, and optionally a throttle that paces the requests made against it. A PostgREST or Supabase REST endpoint is one: baseUrl to /rest/v1, apikey reading {{secrets.*}}.

maxBodyBytes.description: the most an answer from this connection may weigh; past it the request node fails as a fault. Absent: no limit

concurrency.description: at most this many requests in flight against this connection at once; the rest wait for a slot. A whole number, 1 or more

perSecond.description: at most this many requests started against this connection in any one second; the rest wait for the window. Above 0

throttle.description: how requests against this connection are paced. Every node that names the connection shares the one gate, so a map that fans out one request per element is held to it. Absent: no limit
